FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum campaign budget?

Starter packages are shown on the website, while larger or custom campaigns are quoted according to platform, creator mix, deliverables and timing.

How are creators selected?

Creators can be shortlisted according to platform, niche, audience size, average views, campaign fit, availability and the client's budget.

Do you guarantee views or virality?

No campaign can responsibly guarantee a fixed viral result. Creator Promo India can plan reach, placements and deliverables, but actual views and engagement depend on platform distribution and audience response.

Will I receive campaign reporting?

Reporting can include the agreed creator list, post links and available public performance information. The exact reporting scope should be confirmed in the proposal.

Can creators join the network?

Yes. Creators can submit the registration form above with their public profile link, niche and audience details for review.

How quickly can a campaign start?

Timelines depend on creator availability, content approvals and payment/brief confirmation. Urgent campaigns should be discussed directly on WhatsApp.

POLICIES

Clear Terms for Better Campaigns

Privacy

Contact and campaign information submitted through the site is intended for Creator Promo India to review enquiries, coordinate campaigns and respond to creators or clients. Avoid submitting passwords, payment card details or other unnecessary sensitive information.

Campaign Terms

Final creator list, deliverables, posting timeline, pricing, revisions and reporting scope should be confirmed before a campaign begins. Platform performance can vary and viral outcomes are not guaranteed.

Refunds & Cancellations

Refund or cancellation eligibility depends on whether creator bookings, production or placements have already been committed. The applicable terms should be documented in the final campaign confirmation.
